requirement: The proof witness refers to OLD accepted_tail_valid when the corresponding block was accepted, not its later global value. On each actual acceptance, an independent observer records predecessor mask[0]=oldtailvalid and mask[15:1]=all1, plus monotonically ordered accepted block/word identities. These companion observer records follow the literal current/next bank load, shift and promotion including same-edge overwrite priorities. At each actual owned first-header use, assert the exact current word predecessor mask is1 and its predecessor identity is the active STP. No missing marker may force a good mismatch result or suppress the original comparator/fault. A later global accepted_tail_valid==1 is not sufficient proof.
implementation_scope: The mask can be test-only independent observer metadata; it is not a public or functional gating input. If a product companionvalid is added for assertions, it must never bypass mismatch/fault and must be explicitly source-inversed. Exact same-edge acceptance observes oldtail before replacement.
mandatory_counted_boundaries: STP at accepted-block DWORD15, header at next accepted-block DWORD0, including input bubbles and fullbanks.
STP at parser beat lane3, firstheader at nextbeat lane0 and minimum-length carry-end at lane3 in that same beat.
First accepted block after each fault/start/flush/reset/abort has predecessor mask0 at its DWORD0 even though the global tailvalid becomes1 on that acceptance.

Deliberate observer negative using updated/current tailvalid instead of captured old mask must fail the first-block boundary witness; classify this as observer sensitivity, not an electrical or transaction-level DUT failure.
scope: Additive clarification to immutable source-only contract01; no RTL, controls or native launched.
